## The question

How often did the gate accept a wrong change or refuse a right one, what did each check decide alone, and how much rests on the second input? (RQ2, C2, H3) — on the 3,034 candidates saved in E1-v6 and E2-v6b, the 248 directives of the six no-model draws of DiscoPoP alone, and DataRaceBench's labelled kernels. No model call.
